evals.prompt: cotesy append: we decided to use SQLite for the WAL storage because it's already a dependency
evals.expected_output: Resolves the nearest ancestor .cotesy/ scope from cwd and appends a decision entry to its wal.md, with no Source line since --to wasn't used
expectations: Appends a new level-2 heading entry to the nearest ancestor .cotesy/wal.md
Entry does NOT include a **Source:** line
Existing WAL content is preserved, not overwritten

evals.prompt: cotesy append --to ../.. : found a gotcha, the parent config also needs this env var set
evals.expected_output: Targets the given ancestor scope's wal.md directly (must already contain .cotesy/), appends a gotcha entry with a **Source:** line pointing back at the originating (cwd's nearest) scope
expectations: Appends to the --to target scope's wal.md, not the nearest ancestor from cwd
Entry includes a **Source:** line identifying the originating scope
Does not modify the originating scope's own wal.md

evals.prompt: cotesy append: noticed the build script has a bug in a repo with no .cotesy/ anywhere in its ancestry
evals.expected_output: Errors clearly that no .cotesy/ scope was found and suggests running cotesy:init, without creating or writing any files
expectations: Does not create any .cotesy/ directory or wal.md file
Error message mentions no .cotesy/ scope was found
